02 / THE OPPORTUNITY

Creators need viewers.
Hub Ball needs
a reason to be shared.

Hub Ball features

Fans discover relevant videos beside the game or player they care about.

Creators share

A guest story or useful visual gives creators a destination to link to.

Fans return

The next game brings a fresh reason to come back.

Growth hypothesis to test through a small creator pilot.

03 / IDEA 1
The everyday entry point

The fan
reaction

Two or three creator videos directly below the game recap.

The breakdown. The rant. The silver lining. Different ways to process the same game.

Illustrative concept. No real channels or partnerships shown.

Discovery through context

A stat opens
a story.

A relevant video adds a creator’s explanation to the number a fan is exploring.

01

A hitter turns around

A creator breaks down the swing change.

02

The bullpen struggles

A postgame analysis examines the decisions.

03

A scouting video explains what to watch for.

Illustrative pairings. Relevant older videos can keep finding new viewers.

05 / IDEA 3
A home for discovery

Find your
Red Sox people.

A curated directory with channel profiles and favorites.

Smaller channels get a place to be discovered. Every creator gets a profile worth sharing.

Prospects & the farm
Stats & strategy

HUB BALL
06 / IDEA 4
Two takes, one question

“Should Boston
extend him?”

The case for

One creator makes the argument for keeping the player.

The case against

Another explains the tradeoffs and alternatives.

Relevant stats and a fan poll give both audiences a shared place to discuss it.

Represent actual positions fairly. This is an example topic, not a claim about a current player.

HUB BALL
07 / IDEAS 5 & 6

Reasons to return

On game night

The live companion

Scheduled watch-alongs and postgame shows beside the game, with start times and YouTube links.

Help fans find the conversation while it is happening.

Every week

The weekly edit

A short collection of standout breakdowns, prospect reports, funny reactions, and overlooked channels.

Give several creators one page they can share.

HUB BALL
08 / IDEA 7
The strongest collaboration

A creator’s take.
A Hub Ball visual.

“What happened
to the bullpen?”

A creator narrates the story. Hub Ball animates the relevant game data.

One shared destination

Prominent creator credit. A direct channel link. A page fans can open without installing the app.

Illustrative guest story. Use verified data and collaborate with the creator on the original contribution.

HUB BALL
09 / THE PILOT

A focused first release

01

Postgame picks

Manually curate relevant videos. Establish quality before automating discovery.

02

Creator profiles

Launch a small directory with clear channel descriptions and direct links.

03

One guest story

Choose one baseball question and collaborate on a visual feature.

Use official embeds or links with clear attribution. Channel selection and outreach come next.
